claims.text: The cache pod was evicted during a node drain and did not come back on its own.
orders-api fell back to the database for every read, and checkout p95 latency rose to 2.8 seconds for 22 minutes.
External customers in the EU region saw slow checkout and conversion dropped about 4% during the window.
The cache ran as a single pod with no PodDisruptionBudget, so a planned drain took it down.
Its volume was bound to one node, so the pod could not move to another node.
